div.div: Schematic representation of the neuron layer in Kohonen’s model. The nerve fibers running horizontally provide the input signal (“stimulus”) and excite the layer neurons via synaptic connections. Lateral interactions between the neurons constrain the reaction to a spatially bounded “excitation zone.” The layer acts as a “topographical feature map” if the position s of the excitation zone varies in a continuous way with the presence of stimulus features of interest.
